59305374.s: The Darwish Salamah Museum is housed in the home of Colonel pilot Darwish Salamah, who retired after his plane crashed in bad weather. This spurred him to be creative and turn his home into a heritage attraction not to be missed: he made, by hand and using cement and iron, a large collection of more than a thousand models of heritage houses.

59305351.s: Historic Jeddah, known locally as Jeddah Al Balad, lies in the centre of the city of Jeddah. According to some sources its history goes back to pre-Islamic times, and the turning point in its history came in the reign of the Rightly Guided Caliph Uthman ibn Affan (may Allah be pleased with him), who made it the port of Makkah in 26 AH.
59305351.b:
Historic Jeddah, known locally as Jeddah Al Balad, lies in the centre of the city of Jeddah. According to some sources its history goes back to pre-Islamic times, and the turning point in its history came in the reign of the Rightly Guided Caliph Uthman ibn Affan (may Allah be pleased with him), who made it the port of Makkah in 26 AH.

Historic Jeddah has a number of archaeological and heritage landmarks and buildings, such as the remains of the wall of Jeddah and its historic quarters: Harat Al Mazlum, Harat Al Sham, Harat Al Yaman and Harat Al Bahr. It also has a number of historic mosques, the most notable being Uthman ibn Affan Mosque, Al Shafi'i Mosque, Al Basha Mosque, Okash Mosque, Al Mi'mar Mosque and Al Hanafi Mosque, as well as historic markets. On 21 June 2014 it was inscribed on the World Heritage List. In June 2018 King Salman bin Abdulaziz ordered the creation of a department called the Historic Jeddah Project Department, linked to the Ministry of Culture and with an independent budget, based on a proposal by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.

59305316.s: The Abdulraouf Khalil Museum is a museum displaying archaeological collections. It is notable for holding a wide variety of antiquities that go back to the history of the Arabian Peninsula, Saudi culture and Ottoman Islamic civilisation. It also shows the influence of Chinese civilisation and other civilisations such as European civilisation.
59305316.b:
The Abdulraouf Khalil Museum is a museum displaying archaeological collections. It is notable for holding a wide variety of antiquities that go back to the history of the Arabian Peninsula, Saudi culture and Ottoman Islamic civilisation. It also shows the influence of Chinese civilisation and other civilisations such as European civilisation.

The Abdulraouf Khalil Museum is one of the most important and beautiful museums and tourist attractions in Saudi Arabia because of its cultural and archaeological importance. It has been visited by many politicians and princes, most notably Prince Charles and Princess Diana.

59305290.s: A complete city that represents the traditional architectural styles of the Hejaz and contains a museum embodying all kinds of civilisations from before history up to the modern age.
59305290.b:
A complete city that represents the traditional architectural styles of the Hejaz and contains a museum embodying all kinds of civilisations from before history up to the modern age.

The site blends heritage architecture with museum content, holding a wide range of items that reflect the diversity of civilisations across the ages, making it an important destination for lovers of history and heritage in Jeddah.
59305290.a: Rayhanat Al Jazirah, Al Faisaliyyah District, Jeddah

59305285.s: Abraq Al Raghama is an archaeological site east of the city of Jeddah in Saudi Arabia. It was a historic passage on the caravan routes from Jeddah to Makkah. The site became famous as the last point where King Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud camped with his army during the unification of the country before entering Jeddah on 25 December 1925.

The site became famous as the last point where King Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud camped with his army during the unification of the country before entering Jeddah on 25 December 1925.

59300873.s: A 2.2 km walkway with special paths for blind people and people with disabilities, who can stroll and walk for exercise there.
59300873.b:
A 2.2 km walkway with special paths for blind people and people with disabilities, who can stroll and walk for exercise there.

The walkway provides a comfortable environment for walking throughout the day, with dedicated paths that take account of people with disabilities and blind people, making it an inclusive destination for all members of the community.

59300808.s: An aquatic life exhibition with many species of Red Sea fish, as well as dolphin shows, a hall, and a sports club with a swimming pool.
59300808.b:
An aquatic life exhibition with many species of Red Sea fish, as well as dolphin shows, a hall, and a sports club with a swimming pool.

The exhibition gives visitors the chance to learn about Red Sea marine life up close, while the dolphin shows and accompanying sports facilities add an entertaining dimension suited to family visits.
59300808.a: Next to Al Kurnaysh Road, Al Nawras, Jeddah

59300804.t: The Walk Of Prince Faisal Bin Fahad
59300804.s: A very large walkway suitable for walking and cycling.
59300804.b:

59300766.s: The new Corniche project on the Jeddah waterfront is one of the most important attractions for visitors and tourists, with services added for the first time on any of Jeddah's waterfronts. The Corniche is equipped with all the services suited to every group and age, including games and other entertainment.
59300766.b: The new Corniche project on the Jeddah waterfront is one of the most important attractions for visitors and tourists, with services added for the first time on any of Jeddah's waterfronts. The Corniche is equipped with all the services suited to every group and age, including games and other entertainment.

59300762.s: Jeddah Waterfront is a long stretch of coastline overlooking the Red Sea in the Ash Shati district, with walkways, seating and recreational areas suited to all members of the family.
59300762.b:
Jeddah Waterfront is a long stretch of coastline overlooking the Red Sea in the Ash Shati district, with walkways, seating and recreational areas suited to all members of the family.

The waterfront lets visitors enjoy open sea views while strolling or sitting in the areas set aside along the Corniche, making it one of the favourite destinations for family outings in Jeddah.

59300723.s: The waterfront is a favourite destination for family outings, with large open areas set aside for children's games. Adults can take part in a range of water sports on the beach, rent bicycles and ride them along the 4.2 km Corniche, or stroll along the pier.

59300626.s: Sail Island is one of the most important parks and tourist places in Jeddah. It lies on the Jeddah seafront Corniche and is an important entertainment centre visited by people from inside and outside the country. It has a special hall for drawing and colouring where educational and entertainment activities are held for children, as well as swimming pools and a water park.
59300626.b:
Sail Island is one of the most important parks and tourist places in Jeddah. It lies on the Jeddah seafront Corniche and is an important entertainment centre visited by people from inside and outside the country. It has a special hall for drawing and colouring where educational and entertainment activities are held for children, as well as swimming pools and a water park.

The park offers many activities for children and families and provides swimming pools suitable for children, as well as the water park and a number of restaurants. The ticket costs 50 riyals per person including meals, and families can rent private chalets to hold parties.

59300558.s: The idea of the Open Museum is that its works are displayed in the open air, outside buildings, 24 hours a day. The museum has 20 sculptures and artworks by some of the greatest visual artists in the world.
59300558.b: The idea of the Open Museum is that its works are displayed in the open air, outside buildings, 24 hours a day. The museum has 20 sculptures and artworks by some of the greatest visual artists in the world.

59300532.b: Emaar Square consists of three office buildings with luxurious, elegant interior designs, with a beautiful view of the plaza, the interactive water fountain and the luxury shops, and it also offers several varied and distinctive restaurants and cafes.

59300529.b:

59238266.s: Al Raqdi Museum is one of the museums of the Asir region in Abha, founded by Muhammad bin Ali Al Raqdi. The museum has nine sections: copperware; traditional women's clothing and silverware; the old kitchen, handicrafts and farming tools; the old Asiri majlis; the Tihami sitting room; the Asiri village and the art of stone building; the works of the museum's founder; the coastal sitting room; and a section selling heritage and folk items and products.
59238266.b: Al Raqdi Museum is one of the museums of the Asir region in Abha, founded by Muhammad bin Ali Al Raqdi. The museum has nine sections: copperware; traditional women's clothing and silverware; the old kitchen, handicrafts and farming tools; the old Asiri majlis; the Tihami sitting room; the Asiri village and the art of stone building; the works of the museum's founder; the coastal sitting room; and a section selling heritage and folk items and products.
59238266.a: Imam Abdulrahman bin Faisal bin Turki Road, Thirah, Abha

59238031.s: Asir Regional Museum is one of the largest museums in the Asir region. It is in the centre of Abha on King Khalid Street, near the historic Shada Palace, and covers an area of more than 7,000 square metres.
59238031.b:
Asir Regional Museum is one of the largest museums in the Asir region. It is in the centre of Abha on King Khalid Street, near the historic Shada Palace, and covers an area of more than 7,000 square metres.

The museum has eight specialised halls that take the visitor on a journey through the history of the region, covering prehistoric times, the pre-Islamic period, the Islamic eras, the history of the Saudi state in its three phases, and local folk heritage, along with a hall for temporary exhibitions. It holds a collection of rare artefacts that document life in Asir through the ages.
59238031.a: King Khalid Bin Abdul Aziz Street, Town Center, Abha

59237983.s: Shada Palace, or the "White Palace", is one of the most important historical landmarks in the centre of Abha. It was built in 1348 AH / 1929 CE on the instructions of King Abdulaziz and has four floors built of stone, with walls plastered inside and out, and timber used for its doors, windows and ceilings.
59237983.b:
Shada Palace, or the "White Palace", is one of the most important historical landmarks in the centre of Abha. It was built in 1348 AH / 1929 CE on the instructions of King Abdulaziz and has four floors built of stone, with walls plastered inside and out, and timber used for its doors, windows and ceilings.

The palace served for a time as the seat of the emirate of the Asir region, then was restored in 1407 AH and opened in 1408 AH / 1988 CE as a museum of folk heritage. It lies close to the Tuesday folk market and the Asir Regional Museum.
59237983.a: King Khalid Bin Abdul Aziz Street, Town Center, Abha

59237898.s: Al Jahl Museum holds some photographs of the Saudi royal family, old coins, jewellery and silverware, as well as weapons of war of all kinds, old telephones, traditional clothing, farming and kitchen tools, measures and scales, and some copperware and various leather goods.
59237898.b: Al Jahl Museum holds some photographs of the Saudi royal family, old coins, jewellery and silverware, as well as weapons of war of all kinds, old telephones, traditional clothing, farming and kitchen tools, measures and scales, and some copperware and various leather goods.
59237898.a: Mazmah Village Road, Abha, Asir Province

59237896.s: Tabab is a Saudi village in the Asir region, 25 km north-west of the city of Abha. It was built in the era of the First Saudi State and was the first political, cultural and economic capital of Asir during the rule of the First Saudi State (1215-1234 AH) under the emirate of the Al Abu Nuqtah Al Mutahami family. It has several important historical and heritage sites, most notably Tabab Mosque, founded by Prince Abdulwahhab bin Amir Abu Nuqtah Al Mutahami in 1221 AH in the reign of Imam Saud bin Abdulaziz, and the palaces of the emirs of the Al Abu Nuqtah Al Mutahami family. It is currently the seat of their family and of the sheikhdom of the Rabi'ah, Rufaydah and Bani Thu'ah tribes.

59237887.s: Al Ajyal Heritage Museum consists of an independent building with two main halls, the first covering 108 square metres and the second 48 square metres. The museum uses a good variety of display methods, including glass display cases and stands. It holds old manuscripts, documents, coins, jewellery and silverware, as well as weapons and war equipment of all kinds, old telephones, traditional clothing, farming and kitchen tools, measures and scales, palm-leaf work, copperware and various leather goods.

It is one of the most beautiful places in Abha, especially when it rains and fog covers the peaks, giving the place an enchanting scene, which makes it a destination for photography enthusiasts and nature lovers.
